Heute zählt fino zu den Innovationstreibern in den Bereichen Konto- und Datenanalyse, Regulatorik, Steuern und Dokumentenmanagement. title: Join Tech & Data
description:
Wir bauen den modernsten Schraubenhändler für den deutschen Mittelstand. Keine passende Stelle dabei? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Die Rolle schneiden wir um dich.

Was uns anders macht

Unsere Branche bestellt Spezialteile noch per Fax, E-Mail und Excel-Liste. Wir handeln selbst und bauen die Software dafür selbst: von der Anfrage bis zur Lieferung, auf Basis des GSF DataHub und mit AI-nativen Workflows. Wer jetzt dazukommt, ist früh genug dran, um zu prägen, wie alles funktioniert, und spät genug, dass es echte Kunden und echte Daten gibt.

Aufgaben

Daten & DataHub

  • Den GSF DataHub weiterentwickeln, unsere zentrale Datenplattform auf PostgreSQL, BigQuery und firestore
  • Pipelines in Python bauen, Datenmodelle testen und dokumentieren

Integration & Automatisierung

  • ERP, CRM und Lieferanten per API anbinden
  • Prozesse automatisieren: event-driven als Standard, n8n für schnelle MVPs

AI & LLM

  • LLMs in echte Prozesse bringen, etwa für Dokumentenextraktion, Routing und Klassifikation
  • RAG-Workflows bauen, die dank Guardrails und Fallbacks auch produktiv funktionieren

Plattform & Tools

  • CI/CD mit GitHub Actions und Infrastructure as Code mit Terraform auf GCP betreiben
  • Interne Tools bauen, die Vertrieb und Einkauf gerne nutzen

Unser Stack

Python · SQL · PostgreSQL · BigQuery · dbt · React · TypeScript · Google Cloud · Terraform · GitHub Actions · n8n · Claude Code

Qualifikation

Du passt zu uns, wenn …

  • du sicher in Python und SQL bist und schon etwas gebaut hast, über das du gern erzählst, inklusive dem, was nicht funktioniert hat.
  • du in Systemen denkst: Woher kommen die Daten, und was passiert, wenn ein Job um 3 Uhr nachts fehlschlägt?
  • du MVP

Das Produkt steht. Jetzt entscheidet sich, wie wir darüber sprechen.

Das ist kein Callcenter-Job. Keine Kaltakquise, keine gekaufte Liste, keine Quote pro Stunde.
Du kontaktierst Betriebe, die uns bereits kennen. Installationspartner, mit denen wir seit Monaten oder Jahren arbeiten. Sie wissen, wer Bees & Bears ist — sie wissen nur noch nicht, was wir gerade Neues für sie gebaut haben.

Wer wartet, bis jemand den nächsten Schritt vorgibt, auch.

Wohin die Rolle wächst: Sie startet fokussiert: ein Produkt, ein definierter Partnerkreis, ein Gespräch nach dem anderen. Hi, we are AMBOSS, and we are looking for an experienced marketer to drive our growth across Latin America!

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is the copilot for medical professionals, empowering them to provide the best possible care through our learning and clinical decision support tool. Our team brings together care, innovative thinking, and cutting-edge AI medical technology. Since then, we've grown to over 600 employees and are active in over 180 countries - primarily in Germany and the US. Our offices are located in Berlin, Cologne, New York, Cagliari and Cape Town.

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique.

You will work cross-functionally with global teams (CRM, Performance Marketing, Creative, Product) while adapting initiatives to local market nuances, language differences, and region-specific behaviors. This role requires a strategic mindset, strong execution skills, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-evolving environment.

title: Principal Program Manager (f/m/x)
description:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.

Your Mission
As we deepen our collaboration with our parent company, dwpbank, we are looking for a highly strategic and execution-focused person to lead one of our most important cross-company initiatives.

In this role, you will act as the central coordination point for a joint offering with dwpbank. You will bring clarity to complexity, align stakeholders across both organizations, and drive the overall program across commercial, product, and governance workstreams. Your job is to ensure that the right topics move forward, dependencies are surfaced early, and teams stay focused on what matters most.

title: Customer Care & Claims Agent Netherlands (m/f/d)
description:
These tasks are waiting for you

  • You're the first point of contact for our customers and partners in the Netherlands. You take calls and emails, log them properly, and like to sort things out right on the first contact.
  • You take on new claims cases yourself and keep an eye on them proactively, so nothing slips through the cracks.
  • Being reachable and hitting our service levels isn't down to luck for you, it's the result of how independently and responsibly you work.
  • You make sure our customers and partners can always understand how and why we make our decisions.
  • Our CRM (Hubspot) and our self-built contract management system are in good hands with you, you use and maintain both actively.
  • Together with our Operations team, you keep fine-tuning our processes so things run more smoothly for customers, partners, and us internally.


This is what you bring to the table

  • Dutch is your mother tongue and you're fluent in English. German is a nice bonus, but not a must.
  • You bring experience in customer service, customer care, or a service center, and ideally you've already spent some time in the insurance industry.
  • Customer focus, decisiveness, and assertiveness aren't foreign concepts to you, and you communicate really well.
  • You're simply a friendly, open person who enjoys talking, writing, and chatting with customers.
  • Nice to have: you've already worked in a B2B environment, you're interested in our products, you're tech-savvy, and you use AI tools naturally to work more efficiently.

title: Product Marketing Manager, Growth
description:
TL;DR - Lovable's product-led growth motion has been core to its success, and messaging is one of the biggest levers we have to move users from signup to activation to expansion. This role owns that lever: the messaging and positioning strategy for the self serve journey.

You'll own how we talk to self serve users at every stage, from the words in an onboarding email to the framing of an upgrade prompt. You'll partner closely with the Growth PM, who owns the growth roadmap and the product/experimentation strategy behind it, and with our Lifecycle team, who execute lifecycle campaigns day to day. Your job is to bring the messaging point of view: what story we should be telling at each stage, which positioning will land best with which segment, and what new content or messaging should be created to support the roadmap the Growth PM has set.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
Mast is on a mission to make complex lending simple. The UK's specialist lending market is underserved by technology, with legacy systems that can't handle the nuance of complex income, niche products, or the broker workflows that specialist lenders rely on.

We're building modern, cloud-native lending technology, purpose-built for specialist lenders, that helps them process more applications in less time, reach decisions faster, and deliver better experiences for brokers and borrowers.

We're pioneering the use of AI in mortgage origination, building it into the platform from the ground up rather than bolting it onto legacy architecture.. We work with regulated lenders across the UK, have a 100% delivery track record, and are building a high-performance team where everyone has real ownership and direct impact.

About the role

This is not a traditional support role, and you do not need any previous customer support or technology experience to apply.

This role is ideal for a recent graduate or someone early in their career who wants to get into tech. What matters most is your attitude: we are looking for someone curious, reliable, organised, eager to learn, and willing to get stuck in..

You will help lenders, brokers, and internal teams get the best out of Mast. You will answer questions, investigate issues, improve support processes, create documentation, spot recurring product friction, and turn customer conversations into ideas that shape the platform.

You'll report to the Head of Product and work closely with Product, Engineering, Client Success, and Implementation. Over time, this role has the potential to grow into leading Mast's customer support function as the company scales.

We build Cerev CMMS, maintenance software used every day by factories, government buildings, hospitals and property groups across Malaysia. As a Client Success Consultant, you will be with our clients from their first day on Cerev, and you will stay with them long after.      Why we exist   Most buildings and factories in Malaysia still track maintenance on paper, in Excel, or over WhatsApp. Equipment breaks down earlier than it should, not because no one cares, but because no one has a clean record of what needs fixing and when. We want Cerev to be the standard way maintenance is tracked in this country. That does not end once a client is set up. A client who stops using the system after month two has not actually been helped. Someone has to keep them using it properly, long after the excitement of the demo has worn off.      How we work   We are a small team in one office in Ara Damansara, Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm. Small means you are never far from an answer. The engineer who built the feature your client is asking about sits a few desks away. You will hear sales calls, product debates and the odd argument about coffee beans, and you will pick up more in a month here than in a year somewhere bigger. Good news gets shared with the whole team. Problems get solved together, out in the open, not passed around by email.      A real look at our culture   We work by five values: composure, ownership, innovation, candor and excellence. Every company says something like this. Here is what it actually looks like.   Composure. A clien

title: Head of Customer Success Nordics
description: MetaCompliance · Stockholm (hybrid) · Reports to VP Group Customer Operations & International Expansion (UK)       The context in short   MetaCompliance is the leading European Cyber Security Awareness platform - on an ambitious growth journey, backed by Keensight Capital. Recently acquired, Junglemap, the brand Swedish customers know and love, is now coming together with MetaCompliance's wider Nordic customer base under one portfolio, and you own that transition.     The combined customer base makes this the group's second-largest territory after the UK and Ireland. And it doesn't exist as its own build yet — you help shape it.      Yours to build   You'll take on MetaCompliance's combined 1,500-strong Nordic customer base — including 1,000+ customers who already love Junglemap. Your job is to bring them together into one well-run portfolio, without losing what makes Junglemap customers happy along the way.     Nine CSMs report to you. You set the direction, coach, and step into the tough renewals yourself — building the structure this portfolio needs: regular health assessments, clear reporting, and a way of working that scales instead of depending on individual heroics. Leveraging the group's best-in-class CS processes and technology, it will be up to you to shape the CS function for the Nordics.      Digital scale, not more hands   With 1,000+ customers in the Nordic portfolio, we can't run 1:1 customer success on all of them. Digital strategy isn't a nice-to-have here — it is a key element of our scaling Customer Success operation. And ideally you already have AI in your toolkit: not just familiarity with it, but real use of it to scale customer work without losing quality.      The role also asks for something harder to teach   You will form a key part of our bridge between Stockholm, the UK headquarters and our offices around Europe — helping us to be one team with a well-aligned approach to Customer Success, adapted and optimised for the Nordics.

Instead, you will set up the foundations, processes, playbooks, rhythms, and standards that enable our teams in every market to deliver an excellent customer experience. This role is instrumental in partnering across the entire Customer Experience organization as well as the broader Sales teams to further Benchling’s growth. title: Customer Success Manager
description: 합류하게 될 팀에 대해 알려드려요     토스뱅크 Customer Success Manager는 Customer Experience Team의 구성원으로서 함께 할 예정이에요.  Customer Experience Team은 토스뱅크 상담 경험 개선을 위한 정책을 수립하고 운영하고 있어요.  만족스러운 고객경험을 위한 운영 전략을 수립하고, VOC 분석을 통해 고객의 문제를 해결하고 있어요.  VOC 유형을 분석하여 Pain-Point를 도출하고 개선하는 역할을 하고 있어요.       합류하면 함께 할 업무예요      VOC 통역가로 불리며 서비스를 고객의 언어로 전달하고, 고객의 언어를 제품팀의 언어로 번역해서 전달해요.  은행 업무에 대한 전문적인 지식을 바탕으로, 고객 상담을 위한 가이드라인 및 Q&A 등을 제작하여, 상담 팀원과 AI 상담원이 프로페셔널하게 상담할 수 있도록 가이드해요.  채팅 AI , 유선상담의 QA 기준과 평가항목을 설계하고 특성에 맞는 QA 체계를 기획해요.  AI QA 품질을 점검하고, 지식· 응대 로직 등 개선 요건을 도출해 제품팀과 협업해요.  QA 결과를 바탕으로 고객센터 대상 피드백과 교육방향 수립 등을 통해 응대 품질을 지속적으로 향상시켜요.  상담시스템 개발 및 기획요건을 도출하고 제품팀과 협업하여 기능을 개선해요.       이런 분과 함께하고 싶어요     금융 상품의 도메인 지식과 상품기획 부서와의 협업 경험을 3 년 이상 가지고 계신 분이 필요해요.  채팅상담   AICC 를 통한 고객상담 프로세스에 대해 전반적인 이해가 있으신 분이 필요해요.  상담 품질관리(QA) 기준을 직접 설계하거나 평가  분석해 본 경험이 있다면 좋아요.  도급사 SLA(Service Level Agreement) 운영을 통한 고객센터 효율화를 이뤄내신 경험이 있다면 더 좋아요.  SQL 및 SAS, Python, R 등 통계 Tool 을 활용해 직접 데이터를 추출하고, 분석할 수 있는 역량이 있다면 더 좋아요.       이력서는 이렇게 작성하시는 걸 추천해요     토스뱅크 Customer Success Manager 에 지원한 동기와 합류 후 목표에 대해 구체적으로 소개해주시면 좋아요.  금융상품을 다뤄본 업무 경험과 이해도에 자세하게 기재해주세요. (특정 영역의 강점이 있다면 구체적으로 작성해주세요. / 예: 신용카드 교육 업무 3 년)  상담품질 관리나 응대 평가·분석을 경험한 적이 있다면, 어떤 기준으로 무엇을 개선했는지 구체적으로 작성해주세요.  고객관점에서 문제를 발견하고, 개선까지 이끌어 낸 경험이 있다면 구체적으로 작성해주세요.       토스뱅크로의 합류 여정     서류접수 > 직무 인터뷰 > 문화적합성 인터뷰 > 레퍼런스 체크 > 처우협의 > 최종합격 및 입사       꼭 확인해주세요     이력서 및 제출 서류에 허위 사실이 발견되거나 근무 이력 중 징계사항이 확인될 경우, 채용이 취소될 수 있어요.  토스뱅크 내부규정상 결격사유 해당자 또는 금융기관 인력 채용 상 결격사유 해당자는 채용이 취소될 수 있어요.  장애인 및 국가보훈대상자는 지원 시 관련법에 따라 우대하고 있어요.       함께 할 동료를 위한 한마디   "토스뱅크 고객센터는 최고의 앱 경험이 고객상담에도 이어지고, 고객의 궁금증을 사전에 감소시켜 고객의 소중한 시간을 아끼고 있어요."    은행의 여러 상품의 기획 단계에 참여하여 고객이 불편한 지점을 미리 찾아서 반영하고, 출시 후에 발생하는 문제들을 빠르게 개선하고 있어요.  고객과 가장 가까운 곳에서 여러 문제를 해결하며 하루하루 발전되는 경험을 하고 있어요. 은행 도메인의 A~Z까지 경험하고 싶다면, 망설이지 말고 토스뱅크에 합류하세요!
